nom: Geologie Micro Exfoliator & 3 Minute Clay Mask

avis.titre: Nice scrub, but test it first and don’t rub too hard
avis.texte: Full disclosure: I received this product as part of the Amazon Vine Program. I’ve used this product for its exfoliation properties for a few weeks now, and I like it a lot more than similar products I’ve tried previously. The scents I pick up when using it are mostly eucalyptus with a hint of tea tree, making for an earthy scent that would complement products with more “masculine” or “feminine” scents. It’s not too strong of a smell, which I like. There are both chemical and mechanical exfoliators in this product. The product feels like it has sand in it and it, in fact, has “volcanic sand” in its ingredients list. I highly suggest testing the product out on a small patch of skin at first to make sure you’re not rubbing too hard, which can be easy to do if one hasn’t used a mechanical exfoliation product before. My favorite thing about this product is that my skin wasn’t completely dried out after using it for exfoliation. Products like this usually leave my skin feeling parched, but my skin is only slightly drier than usual after using it. Although it makes for a good body exfoliator, I don’t think that’s the best use of it given the amount that comes in the bottle for the price. For facial application once or twice a week at most (per the instructions), a bottle will probably last for several months. I plan to finish the bottle and possibly buy another.

avis.auteur: Fit perfect in mi nissan sentra 2020. Re
avis.texte: I was using for like 4 months a CeraVe gel for black head. It works a little but in one point didn't make any difference. When I started to use this one, after literally 2 weeks of use it 4 times per week ( 2 times for wash my face and 2 times for mask), already removed most of the black head in my face. I had like 10 now I have like 4 left only. I really recommend it.
You only need to use this as a mask once a week and as an exfoliate a couple times a week. it smells divine And my skin and combination with other geologie products looks great

We don't always have time to take care of our skin the way we want, so many of us hire people to follow us around day and night to keep our skin in tip-top shape all the time! I hired someone once but they kept talking, and talking, and talking, so I had to fore them. Now, it is just me and my tube of Geologie Micro Exfoliator & 3-Minute Clay Mask. And it is great! It is a bit steep, for sure, but when you stop and think it is a 3-in-one if you actually do all three things normally -- or have them done...it may be a good thing if you normally spend about that amount cumulatively. In short, as a scrub it is nice. As a mask, even better. And the other use is, well, whatever it is you do, but this is a nice product that holds up to its claim. That 3rd option is as a body exfoliant but if you want to hold on to the quantity here do not do that. In my vast experience in skincare, beauty, and the whole industry in the past, would really be a waste. It is a perfect amount of product to last you some time as a mask and exfoliant on regiments. The smell is nice, your skin should look and feel better, and on my no-problem skin, it made it look and feel ginger-peachy! Will it make you look ten years younger or fix this and that? I believe your diet, environment, regular hygiene, and how well your mind works at combatting the nefarious chatter we all get clobbered by, are the best starting points. When that is in pretty good shape, this product is a nice cherry on top of that. Or chocola
I am very pleased with this facial product. It leaves my face feeling very soft and smooth. Best I have used yet.
I love this stuff! It smells great and makes my skin feel so good. Helps with acne prone skin.

Geologie Micro Exfoliator & 3 Minute Clay Mask I love masks and use an exfoliating one about once a week even though I have super dry skin. This one is meant for oily skin but it still works well for helping with skin cell turnover. It really does dry my skin out so I have to use a lot more moisture on my face after this one. It has made a huge difference in my skin's texture. It took about a tablespoonful to cover my face and you only need to let this sit for 3 minutes for it to dry and then rinse off. It has a strong eucalyptus/tea tree scent This comes in a 4-ounce plastic squeeze tube with a flip cap and is safety-sealed with foil. There is no expiration date but it should be used within 12 months of opening and is made in the USA. #alcohol-free Key Ingredients Anti-acne: Salicylic Acid, Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Leaf Oil Antioxidant: Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Leaf Oil, Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract Exfoliant: Salicylic Acid, Lactic Acid, Glycolic Acid Skin brightening: Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract Skin-identical ingredient: Glycerin Soothing: Salicylic Acid, Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Leaf Oil, Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract ALL INGREDIENTS BY FUNCTION Abrasive/scrub: Kaolin, Hydrated Silica Antimicrobial/antibacterial: Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Leaf Oil Buffering: Lactic Acid, Glycolic Acid, Sodium Hydroxide Colorant: Kaolin Emollient: Cetearyl Alcohol, Isocetyl Stearate, Caprylyl Glycol Emulsifying: Cetearyl Alcoho

This is a really great product. I've used a lot of face masks and exfoliators and this is one of the best ones I've used. It's a great exfoliator. It feels great on your face or your skin and makes your skin feel really smooth and nice. You can also leave it on as a face mask and it does a nice job with that as well. It has light exfoliating granules which give it that spa feel but not too rough. The scent is light and refreshing. You have the tea tree scent but it's not so strong as some tea tree products are. It's just enough to give it kind of a medicinal scent and then the eucalyptus kind of takes over to make it feel soothing and slightly tingly. My face feels really nice after using it and I will definitely continue with it.

I really this mask, it is thick and the beads are small, it felt great on my skin. You can use it three different ways which is very convincing for those who are pressed with time because you can just use it as a scrub. I tried it as a mask; I applied it as the instructions (small amount all over my face) it took about 30-40 seconds before I started to feel the warmth. The instructions also say that it will last about 3 minutes and then you can rinse; I felt the warmth between four to five minutes (I waited until it stop, I wanted to see how long it lasted) and then I rinsed. It left my skin very soft, my pores where much smaller and my skin smelled amazing like eucalyptus & peppermint. Overall I would absolutely recommend this product.

I love skincare and absolutely love masks! This is a great mask even on my dry skin. I need to exfoliate at least twice a week to keep dry skin flakes away and this is a two in one which makes it easier. When you put it on, it feels cooling and you can feel it cleaning your pores. I love the fact that I can exfoliate while I use a mask and it only takes five minutes! After I removed this mask my skin felt so soft and smooth and it made my other skincare glide on so easily. I can only use a clay mask like this twice per month because of my dry skin but I like to use them every week and a half to two weeks to deep clean my pores and this one is absolutely beautiful. I can use this particular mask once per week without issue. That's great for me because I love to use masks and pamper my skin. I have large pores, dry skin, and hormonal acne and this mask works well for me without being overly dry. You can just feel the ingredients working with this mask and I instantly loved it. It does dry down, so rinse off with warm water and you'll have softer, smoother and cleaner skin in only five minutes! I love this mask so much! I don't think anyone would be disappointed with this mask.

If you like the smell of eucalyptus, you’ll love this mask! The scent is strong, but relaxing to wear for a couple minutes. The bottle says to only exfoliate and use this once a week, so the bottle should last me a long time. It makes my skin feel smooth after I wash it off. I also use my facial cleansing brush with this for deeper exfoliation.

avis.titre: Great smelling face mask, only 3 minutes!
avis.texte: I use this face mask once a week, you can feel it working immediately after applying it on your face. It smells great and only takes three minutes to work, after which it leaves my skin feeling soft and refreshed. I have tried it out as a scrub but I prefer to use it as a three minute mask. It's a bit pricey but it works better and smells better than any other scrub I've tried so I would happily recommend it to those in the market for one!

avis.titre: I love the versatility of this product
avis.texte: This exfoliating facemask has a nice pleasant smell. The exfoliating is a fine sand like texture. It does dry like a clay one left on your face for three minutes. Removing with a warm washcloth was pretty easy and it left my face feelingFresh and moisturized. I think this would be a great addition to my weekly routine. Would recommend

The bottle itself is made out of very thick plastic, it is difficult to bend. Therefore, ever since the bottle was less than half used it’s been nearly impossible to get the product out. The first “R” of the three “Rs” of recycling is “Reduce.” This packaging promotes waste by encouraging people to replace it more often than should be necessary.
